units.translation: 95 ⟦1⟧ cf. ⟦2⟧ (better -⟦3⟧ Nauck) Homer N 113. It belonged to ⟦4⟧ . . ⟦5⟧ V. 98 ⟦6⟧; but anacoluthically there is inserted what she has to endure in the way of reproaches because of her own deed, which is after all far from being as bad as that of Orestes against her. The picture of the underworld here corresponds to the usual ones, where all the shades are united; there is no hint that Clytemnestra has now been condemned by the judges of Hades and must suffer torment. V. 96 ⟦7⟧ Aeschylus. ⟦8⟧ (Tyrwhitt, Wakefield) is written instead of ⟦9⟧. ⟦10⟧. because of the scholion: ⟦11⟧, which scholion, however, is very imprecisely formulated and rather attaches itself to 99, where for ⟦12⟧ Weil has written ⟦13⟧ (see below). This seems commendable, but for that ⟦14⟧ 96 is now to be left as it is: cf. numerous passages with this ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧. 1505. ⟦17⟧. 988. 1011 etc. Also ⟦18⟧ is by no means unambiguous.
on whose account I killed Agamemnon, you reject me, and those who killed me are not dishonored

⟦1⟧: cast out from their company (Weckl.); cf. Homer Ψ 74 (Paley), where the soul of Patroclus says: ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ after ⟦4⟧. corresponds to the negation. Her wrath at this unequal treatment makes her repeat it once more, ⟦5⟧ (852) ⟦6⟧; for ⟦7⟧ is in any case to be adopted, with reference of ⟦8⟧ to Agamemnon (= ⟦9⟧), opposite ⟦10⟧ 101, while with ⟦11⟧ the pronoun would have to refer to the ⟦12⟧ and ⟦13⟧ would be rather meaningless. In this assessment of Clytemnestra, her deed and her suffering, the general voice shows itself. Paley compares ⟦14⟧B: ⟦15⟧ – ⟦16⟧ (⟦17⟧) – ⟦18⟧, ⟦19⟧· ⟦20⟧.
but I wander vainly through the wide-gated house of Hades
to you that on behalf of
or one who has laid hold of unjust murders
this one everyone flees and avoids
and neither companion nor guide is willing to be
but she herself wanders in total perplexity

⟦1⟧: again anacoluthic, but this is the usual anacoluthon, see on ⟦2⟧. In the repetition of the thought, which is likewise (see on 98f.) expressed twice, there is a connection to the construction of 101.
